Features:
- Extend the shelf life of food: This vacuum sealer prolongs the life of food by removing most of the air from the airtight bag to reduce oxidation and prevent fresh air from entering the airtight container. Quickly removes air around food and can be used to keep food fresh, such as raw meat, fresh fruits and vegetables. Vacuum sealing process prolongs food freshness
-UNIQUE DESIGN AND SATISFACTION GUARANTEE: This sealer is made of ABS material, durable and easy to clean, with thermal protection features designed for safety. Slim body does not take up space
-Enjoy the perfect taste: ideal for vegetables/meat/fish/fruits/corn/chips, even pickled and salt-ed food can be sealed and kept longer. Plus, vacuum-sealed foods are great for sous-vide cooking and grilling. Tight vacuum seal prevents frozen meat and vegetables from burning in the freezer and keeps ingredients completely free of harmful bugs and bacteri a.
- Simple operation: automatic one-button vacuum sealing operation with smart LED indicator. With two selection modes (sealing and vacuum sealer function), two or more packages can work at the same time to improve efficiency



Specification:
- Colour: Black
- Material: ABS
- Rated voltage: AC100-240V/50-60Hz
- Rated power: 100W

- Product size: 37.2x7.6x4.8 cm/14.6x2.9x1.8 in
- Vacuum bag size: 17x25 cm/6.7x9.8 in



Ease of use:
1. Put the item in the bag. Clean and straighten the open end of the bag to remove dust and smooth out wrinkles or ripples
2. Place the open end of the bag in the vacuum chamber below the air inlet. Don't overfill the bag
3. Close the cover, then press both sides of the cover to lock the buckle
4. Press the "Vacuum & Seal" button, the green LED will flash and the bag will be automatically vacuumed
5. When the LED turns red, the bag will automatically seal
6. When the LED turns green again, the process is complete
7. Open the vacuum release valve to release the vacuum pressure inside the machine
8. Open the top cover and take out the bag. Refrigerate or freeze airtight grocery bags if desired


Cleaning and Maintenance:
1. Avoid using rough materials to clean the machine, so as not to scratch the surface
2. Do not immerse the machine in liquid
3. Make sure the sponge is dry before assembling. During assembly, do not damage it
4. Dry thoroughly before use
5. It is forbidden to wipe with organic solvents, and the machine does not need to be lubricated
6. When the machine fails, the power should be cut off immediately, the cause should be found out, and the fault should be eliminated.
